ITEM 1 | Pale cream-white cubes with smooth, slightly translucent surfaces and crisp edges, about 2-2.5 cm per cube, scattered on the upper-left of the greens; moist, firm, holding shape | 60
ITEM 2 | Orange-salmon chunks and wedges with a slightly fibrous, netted-looking rind-free surface, moist and juicy, about 2-3 cm pieces, arranged on the upper-center of the plate | 70
ITEM 3 | Golden-brown roasted potato wedges with slightly crisp, browned edges and a matte, faintly oily sheen, about 3-4 cm long each, three to four pieces lying on the lower-left of the greens | 90
ITEM 4 | Mixed leafy greens, a mix of bright green curly leaves and dark reddish-purple torn leaves, fresh and slightly glossy with a light dressing sheen, spread across the center-left of the plate | 45
ITEM 5 | Whole strawberries, glossy bright red with green caps, about 3-4 cm long each, two berries sitting on the greens near the center-right | 40
ITEM 6 | Small dark blueberries, deep blue-black with a dusty bloom, scattered in a cluster on the lower-right, roughly 1 cm each, plump and round | 35
ITEM 7 | Chopped nuts (walnut-like pieces) mixed with golden-brown crumbly granola or candied bits, dry and crunchy, with some light caramel-brown clusters, piled on the upper-right of the plate | 35
ITEM 8 | Pale yellow-tan sweet corn-like kernels or golden crumbly bits mixed among the nuts, dry and grainy, small pieces about 0.5-1 cm, on the right side | 15
ITEM 9 | Light brown dressing or sauce smears with a thin, glossy, slightly sticky look, a few droplets along the upper-right rim of the plate | 5
